name: Ono (Fukushima, Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Ono town emblem in navy: an outlined ring open at the bottom with three vertical strokes.
history: Municipal flag of Ono, a town in Fukushima Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field.

features.role: Ono town emblem — an outlined ring open at the bottom with three vertical strokes
